name: mars_spider_thaw
theme: spring at the south pole of Mars, a planetary slice that never leaves the red planet and is NOT a storm world: the translucent dry-ice cap from orbit freckled with thousands of charcoal fans; the cap's crust from low altitude with every fan blown the same way downwind; one araneiform starburst, a net of branching channels carved radially by escaping gas under a clear slab of carbon-dioxide ice; and a gas jet punching basalt dust up through a vent in the slab to fall downwind as a fan. Math personality: dendritic branching (diffusion-limited aggregation), a drainage net carved by gas, not water. Seam: the single jet's fan of branching channels morphs into the whole polar cap from orbit, its thousands of fans read as one pattern. Palette family: dry-ice cobalt & Martian rust.
music_theme: a slow polar dawn on another planet: ice that sighs and cracks as the sun returns, thin shimmering air, patient and vast

registers.name: polar_cap
registers.palette: cobalt-tinted translucent ice cap, rust-orange planet, charcoal fan freckles, thin salmon-pink rim haze, ink-violet void
registers.scene: the south pole of Mars seen from orbit at spring dawn, a vast translucent dry-ice cap with a cobalt sheen spread over the rust-orange planet, the whole cap freckled with thousands of charcoal fans, the low sun raking across it, a thin salmon-pink haze hugging the planet's curved rim, ink-violet void beyond
registers.loop_target: the freckled south polar ice cap of Mars

registers.name: fan_crust
registers.palette: charcoal basalt fans, cobalt-sheened ice crust, rust-orange dust drifts, salmon-pink sky, long violet shadows
registers.scene: the dry-ice crust of the Martian polar cap seen obliquely from low altitude, a wide frozen plain of cobalt-sheened ice scattered with hundreds of charcoal fans all pointing the same way downwind, each fan sprouting from a soot-dark starburst of branching channels, rust-orange dust drifts in the hollows, long violet shadows from a low sun, a thin salmon-pink sky over the curved horizon

registers.name: starburst_net
registers.palette: charcoal channels, cobalt-tinted clear ice slab, rust-orange dust floor, salmon-pink glints
registers.scene: a single starburst net seen from directly above, dozens of charcoal channels branching radially outward from one centre and splitting again and again into finer twigs, all carved into the rust-orange ground under a clear slab of cobalt-tinted carbon-dioxide ice, the slab's cracked surface catching salmon-pink glints from a low sun, a round open vent in the slab at the hub of the branching net

registers.name: dust_jet
registers.palette: charcoal basalt plume, cobalt ice slab, rust-orange ground, salmon-pink sky, violet shadow fan
registers.scene: a gas jet bursting up through a round vent in a clear slab of cobalt-tinted ice, a column of charcoal basalt dust towering into the salmon-pink sky and sheared downwind, the falling dust laying a long charcoal fan across the ice, branching channels radiating from the vent beneath the clear slab, rust-orange ground showing through the cracks
